rules.description: a base family is fixed by a key known at its activation and may be used live
the eligible set at a cut has a parent and a prefix-available condition
the matched set at a cut has a parent, a named comparison and a prefix-available condition
a subgroup selected by an outcome component uses the future of the cut; never used live
a retrospective research set is named as such and never used live
a retrospective condition is never used live
a conditional description names its condition
a stale contract publishes no statistic
no estimate carries its reason and no value
a point estimate has a value and a positive denominator
bounds have both ends and a positive denominator
an index carries a value and no case denominator
a stored research table is quoted, with no value of its own
a complete prefix carries its extreme
an algorithmic region names its algorithm
a comparison may only use features available at the cut
